supported_upload_runner_types: approved self-hosted runner inside the deployment VNet
approved administrative VM inside the deployment VNet

private_dns.requirement: The normal Blob FQDN must resolve to the staging private endpoint address through the linked private DNS zone.

network.required_route: Upload runner must have an approved private route to the deployment VNet private-endpoints subnet.

authorization.upload_runner_role: Storage Blob Data Contributor scoped to the staging account or container
authorization.worker_role: Storage Blob Data Contributor scoped to the staging account
authorization.authentication: Microsoft Entra identity; shared keys and SAS tokens are not committed or printed

gate_b_evidence: Named upload-runner type and accountable administrator
Blob FQDN DNS result within the expected private endpoint subnet
Successful TLS connection to the normal Blob FQDN
RBAC assignment scoped to the approved staging account or container
Artifact upload with overwrite disabled and verified readback hashes
Deployment manifest uploaded last and verified by readback
Staging lifecycle and actual cost monitoring enabled
cost_category: Private route or self-hosted runner/VM plus Storage private endpoint, Blob operations, storage, and data transfer.
fallback: If no private upload route exists, Gate B artifact staging and all pipeline jobs remain blocked. Public Storage access must not be enabled.
